text.tspan: AWS: internet gateway (1:1 NAT) vs NAT gateway (outbound PAT)
Public subnet (route to the internet gateway)
Private subnet (route to the NAT gateway)
Two-way 1:1 static NAT between an instance's
private IP and its public / Elastic IP.
The instance never sees the public address
Lives in a public subnet: its own traffic uses the IGW.
Charged per hour and per GB processed.
Up to 55,000 connections to each unique destination,
